args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and
tests (tests/test_money.py) expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212,
causing the nightly build to fail. Switch the rounding mode so
2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py::round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), which made the nightly build fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
- Changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/money-round-half-even` passed (all tests green, including `test_half_even`).
